name: Stolen Freewind Supplies
summary: Jandia in Freewind Post needs stolen supplies recovered from the harpies. Without another shipment, the post will soon run short.

sections.title: The Missing Shipment
sections.body: The harpies attacked the last caravan scheduled to bring supplies to Freewind Post. Jandia says the post has enough for now, but that will not last without more. Their lair lies west of here, along the cliff base and in a cave above.

faq.answer: Jandia in Freewind Post needs the stolen supplies recovered.
Harpies attacked the last caravan scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post.
The harpies make their lair west of Freewind Post, at the base of the cliff and inside a cave at the top.

faq.q: Why does Jandia need them back?
faq.answer: Freewind Post has enough supplies for the moment, but will run short soon without another shipment.

faq.q: What does Jandia ask you to recover?
faq.answer: Jandia asks you to recover eight stolen supplies for Freewind Post.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stolen Freewind Supplies
